{{Top|leg}}
'''Bamfurd's Tapcafe''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] specialized in local dishes and operating in the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. As it was well-light and particularly clean, it was popular among tourists. The business was owned by the [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Bamfurd]], who commonly served personally any client, particularly new clients.
